mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Ad-hCMV-Flt3L is a gene therapy that uses an adenoviral vector to deliver the Flt3L gene, which encodes the Fms-like tyrosine kinase 3 ligand, a protein that can stimulate the immune system by promoting the proliferation and differentiation of dendritic cells and other immune cells.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Gene delivery of Flt3L to stimulate immune cell proliferation and differentiation.

data_notes.record_scope: Ad-hCMV-Flt3L is an investigational gene therapy product primarily studied in preclinical and early-phase clinical trials.
